drafts.title: AAA winter EV cost: $32 at home vs $77 public
drafts.body:
$77 vs $32. That's the extra winter cost AAA measured per 1,000 miles at 20°F on public chargers versus plugging in at home.

Range dropped about 39% in the cold. Precondition while plugged in and use seat heat first.

What's your winter range drop?
bullets: AAA (May 1, 2026 lab study): at 20°F vs 75°F, EVs lost about 39% calculated range and added ~$32.11/1,000 mi at home rates vs ~$76.93 on public charging.
AAA tip: precondition cabin and battery while plugged in; use seat and wheel heat instead of blasting cabin heat.

drafts.title: $77 extra per 1,000 cold miles on public chargers
drafts.angle: Cold is coming to the Western Slope. AAA put hard dollars on winter EV costs, and the garage plug wins. Not a rehash of a vague "cold morning %" stub.
bullets: AAA (May 1, 2026 lab study): at 20°F vs 75°F, EVs lost about 39% calculated driving range and 35.6% MPGe.
Extra operating cost per 1,000 miles at 20°F: about $32.11 when charging at home rates, about $76.93 on public charging.
Same cold test: EVs were about $36 cheaper per 1,000 miles than hybrids on home power, but about $86 more expensive than hybrids on public chargers.
AAA tip: precondition cabin/battery while plugged in; use seat and wheel heat instead of blasting the cabin.
drafts.body:
$77. That's the extra cost AAA measured per 1,000 cold miles if you lean on public chargers. At home it was closer to $32.

At 20°F they saw about a 39% range drop vs a mild day. Tonight I'm [preconditioning while plugged at ___ / checking seat heat first]. Last week's home rate was about [what I paid per kWh at ___].

The savings live in the garage. Public DCFC in winter is the expensive path.

What's your winter range drop so far this year?
drafts.ocr_why: Dollar first, actionable tip, owner-to-owner. Clear home vs public gap.
drafts.pixel: Show the Tesla climate precondition screen while the car is plugged in: "Do this before you unplug."
drafts.target: A verified Tesla owner posting winter tips, or quote AAA's own post if they share the study. One-line opinion on home plug vs public in cold.

drafts.angle: AI that helps older ears at a noisy restaurant, without turning into a spy-gadget pitch. Honest "useful or creepy?" question. Do not rehash the TikTok on-device AI post already LIVE.
bullets: TechCrunch (Nov 2, 2026): Apple Watch Series 12 "Live Rewind" entered developer beta with iOS 27.3.
Double-press Digital Crown -> text snippet of the last 15 seconds; save to Siri app or ask Siri; unsaved snippets vanish after about 30 seconds.
Audible chime + on-watch animation so people around you know something was captured.
Apple says it does not store raw audio; Siri Recaps summarize (not full transcripts), strip sensitive IDs, and auto-delete unreviewed notes in about 7 days.
Aimed at missed directions, restaurant specials, parent-teacher meetings; opt-in / scheduleable.
